eventDetail.scope: The 20th IEEE International Conference on Vehicular Electronics and Safety (ICVES 2026) is an annual forum sponsored by the IEEE Intelligent Transportation Systems Society (ITSS). It serves as a premier interdisciplinary platform for the presentation and discussion of the latest advances and research findings in the field of intelligent vehicular electronics and safety. The conference brings together leading academic researchers, scholars, and industry experts from around the world to exchange knowledge, foster collaboration, and promote innovation in this rapidly evolving domain.
